text: Android: redeeming a pasted invite should accept the full URL, not only the bare token

Fixed. extractInviteToken() extracts the token from a pasted /invite/<token> URL (path-prefix, trailing slash, query, fragment tolerated) while still accepting a bare token; redeem() uses it. App-Link deep-link path was already handled in Nav.kt. Commit 0ca508f. RedeemViewModelTest + full Android suite + lint clean.
